The developments follow Houthi strikes on King Khalid and Abha Airports in Saudi Arabia on October 6 and 7 and an escalating conflict in Yemen. In a statement, GACA said, "On Saturday, October 10, 2026, corresponding to 29 Rabi' Al-Thani 1448H, King Khalid International Airport was targeted by an attack, amid ongoing blatant attacks targeting civil aviation facilities in the Kingdom." "The attack resulted in a number of injuries, which are currently being assessed," the authority said, adding that operations had been temporarily suspended pending damage assessment and safety inspections of airport facilities in coordination with the relevant authorities. "Further updates will be provided," GACA said. https
